sections.label: Cybersecurity and Smart Nation
sections.summary: Strong cybersecurity provides a strong and sure foundation for building a Smart Nation, not affecting the initiative or reputation.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Page: 33 Madam, far from affecting the Smart Nation initiative or our reputation, strong cybersecurity provides a strong and sure foundation for building a Smart Nation.

sections.label: Internet separation decision
sections.summary: Anti-viruses stop only about 20% to 30% of malware, so after long deliberation the best way decided was Internet separation, balancing costs and usability, with public officers surfing the Internet on different devices.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Clearly, putting in enough anti-viruses into our system is not sufficient because the experts will tell you it can only stop about, maybe, 20% to 30% of the malware.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We deliberated this for a very, very long time and we decided that the best way is to do an Internet separation.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We have to balance this against costs and usability and given the fact that Internet facing is always a challenge for us, we thought it was better to have a separate system altogether, allowing, of course, public officers to still surf the Internet on different devices.

sections.label: One year given
sections.summary: They have given themselves one year, as mentioned in the reply.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: As I have mentioned in my reply, we have given ourselves one year.
